CTA.heading: Are You Ready to Walk the Path?
CTA.body: The door is open, but only you can choose to step through it. If you feel the call, let's start with the beginning: the Life Activation.

Guide.body1: Radu Coman is a Guide and Teacher in the lineage of King Salomon, certified by the <mms>Modern Mystery School</mms>. With years of dedicated training and a deep passion for empowering others, Radu has made it his mission to bring the ancient teachings to the heart of Europe.
Guide.body2: Having previously served the community through his work at <usuflet>universitateapentrusuflet.ro</usuflet>, Radu has now transitioned to serving the people in the area of Prague by making the path of initiation available to those in the region. He is providing an immersive experience for those who are truly ready for transformation.
Guide.body3: His approach combines the timeless precision of the ancient mystery school teachings with a modern, grounded understanding of what it means to live as an awakened being in today's world.
Guide.quote: My purpose is to guide you home and help you express your truest self.
Guide.dianaBody1: Diana Coman brings a deeply intuitive and human-centered approach to the work. Her strength lies in perceiving the person in front of her, recognizing the patterns beneath what they are experiencing, and translating the teachings into something personal, practical and embodied.
Guide.dianaBody2: Her path here was shaped by a lifelong quest to truly understand human nature and consciousness. That search took her through art, symbolism, astrology, and various healing modalities. She refined her experience by walking the path of the initiate within the <mms>Modern Mystery School</mms>. Everything she'd only had glimpses of before came together into a clear masterpiece that is her life today.
Guide.dianaBody3: Together with her husband Radu, she leads, teaches and heals those who wish to walk the path as well, and helps build the Prague community — sharing these ancient, transformative practices to help others bridge the gap between theory and reality, from simple curiosity to profound personal mastery.
Guide.dianaQuote: There is a difference between hearing that something is possible and experiencing it yourself. The second changes everything.

Welcome.heading: Hi, we're Diana and Radu
Welcome.body: We'll welcome you in person in Prague, take the time to listen, and guide you through every step. Whether you come for a healing, a class or a calm evening with the community, you won't be on your own.

items.q: I'm new to this — where should I start?
items.a: Begin with a Life Activation — a gentle, profound entry point that needs no prior knowledge or spiritual background. If you'd like guidance first, reach out on WhatsApp and Radu or Diana will help you find the right first step.

items.q: What is the Modern Mystery School, and the lineage of King Salomon?
items.a: A spiritual lineage tracing back over 3,000 years, carried hand to hand through initiation rather than written teaching alone — not a recent pop-up, but a system handed down intact from teacher to student, refined for many generations.

items.q: Do I need to believe in anything specific for this to work?
items.a: No. Bring your doubts with you if you have them — most people who walk this path did too, when they started. You don't need a particular belief system, only a willingness to show up, receive with an open mind and do the work that is presented to you to experience the transformation for yourself.

items.q: How is this different from therapy or coaching?
items.a: This is spiritual and energetic work, not a medical or psychological service — it doesn't replace therapy or any treatment prescribed by a doctor. Many people do both, side by side.

items.q: How do I know which session is right for me?
items.a: Reach out on WhatsApp and share a little about what's going on — Radu and Diana will guide you to understand what will benefit you the most in your current situation.

Ending.heading: Ancient wisdom for modern life
Ending.body1: What we teach comes from the <emphasis>ancient mystery schools</emphasis> and the <emphasis>universal science</emphasis> they preserved, and it is surprisingly practical for life today.
Ending.body2: It is for <emphasis>modern men and women</emphasis> who want to feel better, understand themselves and live with more purpose and joy.

letter.body5: If you feel that life has a deeper architecture… If you've always known, somewhere inside, that you are here for something more—even if you haven't yet been able to name it… Then this step may be your next beginning.

FullSpiritActivation.soulBody2: In a more tangible sense, it unlocks the channels of consciousness within the body, revitalizing the nervous and sensory systems. This allows us to connect more deeply to our physical sensations — free from the emotional and mental blocks that may have limited us in the past — filling us with a radiant vitality and an overwhelming joy for life.

SacredGeometryPage.introBody1: You have probably felt it: some rooms make you calm and clear, others leave you tired or tense. A space holds the energy of the people and moments it has seen, and that energy affects you. Sacred geometry gives you a simple way to change it.
SacredGeometryPage.introBody2: This workshop is for anyone who wants the real, practical use of sacred geometry, not just the theory. In 4.5 hours, in a small group, you learn the three primary shapes, how to clear negative energy from yourself and from a room, and how to create a sacred space: a calm, protected place at home, at work or wherever you go. It's the same geometry that inspired Pythagoras, Leonardo da Vinci and Tesla.

SpiritualIntuitionPage.introBody2: In this workshop you learn what your spiritual senses are, how to activate and strengthen them, and how to build your awareness and sensitivity safely and comfortably. Working with these senses invites you to use more of your brain's capacity. The more you can perceive, the more you can achieve in life.

SpiritualIntuitionPage.didYouKnowIntro: Your physical senses pick up only a small part of what is really there.

didYouKnow.title: You see only a sliver of light
didYouKnow.text: Visible light is a tiny slice of the electromagnetic spectrum. Bees see ultraviolet patterns on flowers that are invisible to us.

didYouKnow.title: Most of the universe is unseen
didYouKnow.text: Everything we can see and touch makes up only about 5% of the universe. Scientists call the rest dark matter and dark energy.

didYouKnow.title: Trillions of particles pass through you
didYouKnow.text: Every second, trillions of tiny particles called neutrinos pass straight through your body, and you feel nothing.

didYouKnow.title: Your brain fills in the gaps
didYouKnow.text: Each eye has a blind spot. You never notice it, because your brain fills in the missing part of the picture.

TestimonialsPage.heading: The Journey of Transformation

maria.name: Maria - Mother, CEO and Healer
maria.role: Life Activation Practitioner, Prague, Czech Republic

qa.q: What brought you to Healers Academy?
qa.a1: I found myself at a moment where my life was changing a lot. I'd built a successful company over 20 years and raised a beautiful family. But the kids were starting to move out, and I felt a deep calling to the mystical island of Samotraki, sensing that my role as a CEO was coming to an end.
qa.a2: On Samotraki, I had a clear inner calling that I was always part of the Mystery Schools. Then I found an Instagram post from Diana saying "Mystery School in Prague." I knew I had to explore it, and the rest is history.

qa.a1: Very healing. I feel very light and at peace. The energy here is beautiful, and the people are beyond lovely. I've become much more sensitive to the energies and what surrounds me.

The initiation ceremony was beyond my imagination. I realized how much I was missing being part of a community. I felt genuinely welcome and it truly feels like I've found a community that I'm super happy to belong to.

During the Aura healing, I felt the light—I was dancing in the light. It was beautiful and amazing. And when I was able to give a session, I just knew that I was born to do that. Someone told me I'm filled with grace and beauty, which gave me the empowerment to do it more.

qa.q: How will your life shift now?
qa.a1: It's a mystery. I don't know. But that's the beauty, right? I feel like stepping into the unknown was always very scary for me. But now that I feel like I'm on the path of light, the path will reveal itself. It will be just like stepping into light and a bridge of golden light will unfold.

qa.q: What do you feel the benefits are in having a spiritual guide in this modern day world?
qa.a1: The first thing that I understand is that Radu didn't tell me what to do and what not to do. He really helps me to hear my own truth, my own clarity. What I received was clarity and emotional safety and the permission to trust myself again.
qa.a2: I believe that real benefits of having a spiritual guide is not direction, but remembering who you already are in your everyday life.

qa.q: What would you say to people seeking a spiritual guide?
qa.a1: You just need to come back to yourself. You need to go deeper; you need to really understand who you are. This journey for me was amazing. It was hard, but I found myself; I found the love that I needed.
qa.a2: Everyone just needs to really go and start to know themselves—this is the most important thing.

qa.a1: Healing doesn't have to be fast. You don't need to rush, fix, or become someone else to be worthy. Those just beginning don't need to be 'fixed'—they need gentleness.
qa.a2: I also needed to hear that my sensitivity is not a weakness, it's actually my greatest trait. I wasn't broken; I was just disconnected from myself. Now that I'm connected, I started to see the power, the strength, and the love.

qa.q: How have the tools and practices helped you?
qa.a1: The work with the body, with moon cycles, with rituals, with meditation—it's so important. It's not easy, it's really hard, but when you put it inside and work with yourself, you get it.
qa.a2: I'm so thankful that I was made to feel safe to be the way I am, who I am. It made me feel like I could trust myself again and remember who I am.

LineagePage.metaTitle: The Lineage of King Salomon | The Path of Initiation Prague
LineagePage.metaDescription: Over 3,000 years of unbroken written lineage. Discover the Modern Mystery School, the King Salomon Lineage, and the three Lineage Holders of the Third Order — Gudni Gudnason, Hideto Nakagome, and Dave Lanyon.
LineagePage.heroBody: Over 3,000 years of written history. An unbroken chain of teacher to student, affirmed by the holy process of initiation — preserving the keys to true spiritual power since the beginning of time.
LineagePage.whatIsLineageHeading: The measure of an authentic Mystery School
LineagePage.whatIsLineageBody1: Lineage is a key and important factor in determining the legitimacy, integrity and authority that an authentic Mystery School holds. By definition, lineage means a lineal descent from an ancestor — an ancestry, a pedigree.
LineagePage.whatIsLineageBody2: <mms>The Modern Mystery School</mms> has persisted through time an ancient tradition of sharing knowledge from teacher to student, affirmed by the holy process of initiation. This direct transfer of information has preserved the virtue and honour of the mystery school tradition, which has held the secrets of God, the universe, and the keys to true spiritual power since the beginning of time.
LineagePage.whatIsLineageBody3: This wisdom and power is available to all who truly seek it and are willing to honour its sacred nature by walking the Path of Initiation.

quote.caption: Hermes Trismegistus · Floor of Siena Cathedral, c. 1488

LineagePage.ksLineageBody1: The lineage of the <mms>Modern Mystery School</mms> dates back to the time of King Salomon and therefore carries over 3,000 years of written history and lineage. While the mystery school tradition is far older, the lineage of the MMS and its teachings can be verified and traced directly to the teachings of King Salomon himself.
LineagePage.ksLineageBody2: The oral tradition reaches back more than 8,000 years to the time of Hermes — Hermes Trismegistus. Initiation, combined with this unbroken lineage, empowers the Adept to engage in the Great Work: creating a better world and living in accordance with their true potential and life purpose.
LineagePage.ksLineageBody3: The great masters have all walked upon the Path of Initiation in the mystery school tradition — the very path that led them to fulfill their promise to God while here on this earth.
LineagePage.thirdOrderBody: All lineages have main key holders — individuals who hold and anchor the lineage on the planet, with the authority to keep the door of the Mystery School open to those who seek the Light. In this lineage they are titled the Third Order, and in union they maintain the purity of the lineage and its teachings.
LineagePage.thirdOrderClosing: Today, these three lineage holders carry the great responsibility of maintaining the purity of the teachings — working in collaboration with the Council of Twelve women and the wider leadership, stewarding the lineage of King Salomon into the modern age.

SoulRetrieval.heroSubtitle: When a part of you feels missing
SoulRetrieval.heroTagline: A gentle healing to bring back the joy, energy and spark you lost along the way
SoulRetrieval.introLead: Have you ever felt that a piece of you is missing?
SoulRetrieval.introBody1: Maybe it started after a loss, a break-up, an accident or a long, exhausting time. You kept going, as we all do, but something changed. Life feels a little flatter. The joy, the creativity or the spark you used to have seem far away.
SoulRetrieval.introBody2: In the Mystery School tradition we understand this as a part of the soul that stepped away to stay safe when things became too much. Hermetic Soul Retrieval gently finds these parts and brings them home, so you can feel whole again. You don't need to relive or talk through painful memories for it to work.

EmotionalCordCutting.heroSubtitle: When someone still lives in your thoughts, and it costs you energy
EmotionalCordCutting.heroTagline: A gentle ritual to let go of old ties, so you can feel like yourself again
EmotionalCordCutting.introLead: When life feels heavy, sometimes the first step is simply to let go
EmotionalCordCutting.introBody1: Every person we love, argue with or miss leaves a trace in us. We call these traces energetic cords. Most of them are harmless. But some keep pulling at you long after the relationship or the moment is over: you replay old conversations, you come home tired after seeing certain people, or a name alone is enough to unsettle you.
EmotionalCordCutting.introBody2: In this session we gently cut those draining ties and clear what they left behind. It doesn't erase love or end a relationship. It simply gives your energy back to you, so you can meet the people in your life from a lighter, freer place.
signs: You keep thinking about someone, even when you'd rather not
You come home tired after seeing certain people
You feel stuck, as if you can't quite move on
Hearing a particular name still makes your stomach tighten
You've lost your spark and catch yourself reaching for comfort habits
You soak up other people's moods without meaning to

protocol.label: We start with a conversation:
protocol.text: We take a few minutes to understand what is going on for you and what you are ready to let go of. You only share what feels comfortable.
